title: Rich-editor swarm-author AccessKit surface (SetValue/ReplaceSelectedText + wikilink-by-id)
origin: Discovered by MT-043 (E7 SwarmEditProof) — the end-to-end swarm proof STOPs at STEP 3 (PROOF_FAIL) because the rich editor has NO swarm-edit AccessKit surface (the mirror of MT-080 code-editor SetValue/ReplaceSelectedText + consume_swarm_text_actions does not exist for the rich editor). MT-043 STEP 3 (add a backlink via the rich editor purely via AccessKit) cannot pass until this lands.

scope.summary: Give the rich/markdown editor the same out-of-process swarm-author AccessKit surface the code editor got in MT-080: the rich-editor text node advertises Action::SetValue + ReplaceSelectedText, a consume_swarm_text_actions-equivalent applies a dispatched SetValue(ActionData::Value)/ReplaceSelectedText to the rich DocJson model (through the MT-035 undo bus, not set_text-bypass), and a headless wikilink-target-by-id activation surface (an hsLink atom carrying a specific refValue) lets a swarm agent pick a wikilink target without a live search. No keystroke simulation; genuine AccessKit-by-id dispatch.

acceptance_criteria: The rich-editor text node advertises Action::SetValue + Action::ReplaceSelectedText via AccessKit (mirror code_editor_text panel.rs:7887).

A dispatched raw AccessKitActionRequest{SetValue, target: rich text node id, Value(agent text)} mutates the rich DocJson buffer with the agent-produced content, routed through the MT-035 unified undo bus (not a set_text bypass), proven by a real kittest.
A headless wikilink-target-by-id surface: an hsLink atom exposes a stable author_id and accepts an activation that sets its target refValue without a live backend search, proven by a real kittest.
MT-043 STEP 3 (add a backlink via the rich editor purely via AccessKit) now PASSES; re-run test_e7_swarm_edit_proof so the proof-log fixture ends PROOF_PASS (all steps GATED/PASS, no BLOCKED).
No keystroke simulation (AC-043-07); no SQLite; theme tokens; poison-safe locks; disabled-not-dead invariant preserved.
proof_targets: cargo test -p handshake-native --test test_e7_swarm_edit_proof -- --test-threads=1  (STEP 3 PASS, log PROOF_PASS)
cargo test -p handshake-native <rich swarm surface test bin>  (SetValue mutates DocJson via undo bus; wikilink-by-id activation)
